hero.title: Permanent makeup treatments
hero.text: From natural Powder Brows and Combi Brows to Lip Blush, Permanent Eyeliner and Faux Freckles — explore all our PMU treatments, performed by certified specialists.

intro.title: Which treatment suits you?
intro.text: Every treatment starts with a personal consultation, so we can define together the shape, colour and technique that best suit your wishes and features.

groups.heading: Brows
groups.text: Fuller, defined brows that look natural — for years.

items.title: Ombré Powder Brows
items.text: Softly faded, powdery brows with a natural makeup effect.

items.title: Touch-up Powder Brows
items.text: Refresh your existing Powder Brows and keep the colour smooth and even.

items.title: Combi Brows
items.text: The combination of hairstrokes and shading for the most realistic result.

items.title: Brow Lamination
items.text: Groomed, brushed-up brows without pigment — for a fuller look.

groups.heading: Lips
groups.text: More colour, definition and volume for a fresh, natural look.

items.title: Lip Blush
items.text: Subtle colour and definition for fuller, fresher lips.

items.title: Lip Enlightenment
items.text: Brighten and even out lip colour for a natural result.

groups.heading: Freckles & more
groups.text: From playful faux freckles to permanent eyeliner.

items.title: Faux Freckles
items.text: Natural, bespoke freckles, perfectly placed for a playful look.

items.title: Permanent Beauty Spot
items.text: A subtle, natural beauty mark exactly where you want it.

items.title: Permanent Eyeliner
items.text: Define your eyes with a crisp, long-lasting eyeliner.

items.title: Infralash Eyeliner
items.text: A soft, natural lash enhancement between the lash line.

groups.heading: Correction & removal
groups.text: Correct or remove old or unsuccessful PMU.

items.title: Colour correction PMU
items.text: Correct a discoloured or wrong pigment colour from earlier PMU.

items.title: Cover old PMU
items.text: Blend old permanent makeup into a fresh, natural new result.

items.title: Micro Scalp Pigmentation
items.text: Create the illusion of fuller hair or a fuller hairline.

items.title: Permanent Makeup Removal (laser)
items.text: Have old or unwanted PMU safely and effectively removed with our YAG laser.

items.title: Tattoo Removal
items.text: Have old or unwanted tattoos removed quickly and effectively with our YAG laser in Rotterdam and Amsterdam.

items.title: Laser Hair Removal
items.text: Get lasting freedom from unwanted hair growth with professional laser technology.

cta.title: Book a no-obligation appointment
cta.text: During a personal consultation we discuss your wishes and advise the best treatment.
